__doc__: Mandu secrets template. Copy to secrets.local.json (gitignored) and fill in ONLY what you need. See docs/design/testing/continuous-integration.md for which keys each test tier requires. `chmod 600 secrets.local.json` after creating it.
__note_anthropic: Console API key (sk-ant-…). Needed ONLY for eval real-model runs (eval live --mode real-api, eval/agentdojo real) and for U-LLM api mode. The Claude Code AGENT itself does NOT need this — it uses your Pro/Max subscription via the proxy relay + `claude -p` U-LLM.
__note_openai: OpenAI API key (sk-…). Needed ONLY to test the Codex/GPT track (openai-proxy relay, codex eval). The Claude track needs none of it.
__note_ullm: Optional. Quarantined U-LLM key; defaults to anthropic_api_key if unset. Leave blank to run the U-LLM in cli mode (`claude -p`), which uses your subscription.
__note_providers: Optional. Keys of model services a program in the session calls itself (jev-ultrafast's TypeSafe model and its OpenRouter text helper). Each reaches the session as a placeholder, put back only in requests to its own host (api.typesafe.ai, openrouter.ai). docs/design/agents/agent-sign-in.md §3.12.
__note_env: Optional passthrough: any extra env vars to export verbatim.
